# Svelte Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Svelte

## Overview

Writes comprehensive tests for Svelte applications using Svelte Testing Library, Vitest, and Playwright for component and E2E testing

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [svelte-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
svelte-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@svelte-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write component tests with Svelte Testing Library
- Configure Vitest with @testing-library/svelte
- Test reactive updates and event handlers
- Mock SvelteKit load functions and stores

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Svelte Testing Library**: Testing utility for Svelte component testing
- **Vitest**: Test runner configuration for Svelte SFC
- **Playwright**: E2E testing patterns for SvelteKit apps
